message:
Now I understand the fuzzer harness. The input is a HEVC bitstream. The vulnerability is a "Use-of-uninitialized-value in ihevcd_fmt_conv". Let me look at the `ihevcd_fmt_conv_420sp_to_420p` function and related functions to understand where uninitialized values could be read:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "ihevcd_fmt_conv_420sp_to_420p\b" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/decoder/ihevcd_fmt_conv.c | head -5 && echo "===" && sed -n '1,100p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/decoder/ihevcd_fmt_conv.c</｜｜DSML｜｜>
